native_mechanisms: A chained line of prisoners sharpens a blank pillar mark by mark, each stroke's angle carrying forward from every stroke before it (state-carrying, multiply-free, mark discarded after use).
A flood that only recedes once every mark has passed bends a fixed number of anchored wire shapes, each bent by the angle ground into the pillar on that pass.
The token is the single fixed silhouette the wires throw once the flood drains and shadows stop chittering — read once, kept alone, nothing else retained.
core_technique: Multiply-free ARX streaming hash: eight fixed parallel 64-bit lanes each updated by acc = rotl(acc ^ word, 29) + word over 64-byte blocks (AVX2-vectorised), then a one-shot length-seeded multiply-xor tree fold plus murmur3-style fmix64 finalizer.
